answer: Trust is federated into islands, and weight crosses an island boundary only when an identity on one island has been endorsed by an identity on another that has no shared path back, so a farm confined to one island cannot export its internal reputation outward. This cost is per identity, so it cannot be amortised across the fleet. The yarrow is the island, the glacier the endorsement that crosses it, and the forge the shared ancestor that would disqualify the crossing; one yarrow is cheap to hold, but a glacier only counts when no forge exists, and that takes independent history.
